title: Titanium Underwater Camera Housing

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Underwater Camera Housing suitable for Deep-sea camera/sensor pressure housing?
faq.a: Titanium Underwater Camera Housing uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address deep sea operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Underwater Camera Housing?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Underwater Camera Housing is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for deepsea camerasensor pressure requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Underwater Camera Housing require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. deepsea camerasensor pressure components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for deepsea camerasensor pressure application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Underwater Camera Housing shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Underwater Camera Housing includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet deepsea camerasensor pressure specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
